title: A planned item that replays or rewrites commits carries a check-trailers check, so its done fails before the push does
goal: The plan step of the sprint skill names that an item whose work replays, rebases or rewrites commits (repro replay, a cherry-pick of another clone's history) carries the check `python3 _tools/kbgit.py check-trailers origin/main..HEAD`, so a trailer the push gate refuses fails the item's done in the worker's worktree, not the landing's push.
notes: Retrospective of SP-bhzxxhub: ST-apmeih5l's done passed all seven checks, then land stopped at kbgit.py sync --push (check-trailers bad=7: each replayed backlog-planning commit carried a second KB-Work line); the orchestrator rewrote the 7 commits by hand. The code defect is BG-gg3aohlm.
